data.to:
CLAUDE.md describes files that no longer exist: form.py, simplify.py, generate.py, dataset.py, cli.py and a 'bench generate' command. Agents that read it look for the wrong files.

The real package is src/lofbench/. It contains:
- core.py: form representation, simplification, generation and DIFFICULTY_CONFIGS
- renderers/: a registry of dialect renderers (canonical, noisy_parens, circle, nested_list, sexpr)
- datasets/factory.py: builds inspect-ai samples for text and image dialects
- tasks/: inspect-ai task definitions (single.py, composite.py, prompts.py)
- scorers/lof_scorer.py: scoring
- analysis.py: loads inspect logs into pandas

Rewrite the overview, architecture and commands sections of CLAUDE.md to match this. Keep the Lattice section unchanged. Check README.org examples against the current exports in __init__.py. Check agents.md for the same staleness. Every command listed must actually run.

data.body: Adversarial plan review (agent:claire-plan-reviewer-c). Verified against real code. Central factual fixes all CONFIRMED true: composite_lof_task group_size default = 4 (tasks/composite.py:19) vs README.org:52 which says 8 -> fix is correct; README renderer row lists only (canonical, noisy_parens) (README.org:52) -> broadening warranted; the actual registered keys are canonical, circle, nested_list, noisy_parens, sexpr (verified via list_renderers()) so the plan's use of 'circle' (not svg_circle) is the CORRECT name -- note DB-6's plan gets this wrong; notebooks/ exists so keeping the Constraints bullet is right; prompts.py keeps ()() = () and (()) = nothing (lines 11,15) as DB-7 also relies on; no bench CLI / no cli.py confirmed. Scope boundary is sound and NOT an orphan: DB-1 correctly refuses the single.py suite_version/dialect_id/family/form_id stamp and get_log_metadata rewrite as code, and DB-4's plan M8 (lines 126-134) explicitly OWNS that work (with a conditional offer to lift it into a DB-1 ticket). So the stamp is owned by DB-4 M8; the only residual is that the orchestrator should nail down which ticket carries M8 to avoid a merge-boundary race, but no plan drops it. Acceptance criteria are tight and include an explicit anti-lazy clause (line 105). No blocking findings. PASS.

Implementation done on branch chore/DB-1-docs-refresh (commit 22ecd97, in worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-a28fc44555f0dba82). CLAUDE.md rewritten per plan: overview note added, Development Commands replaced with real inspect-ai commands, Architecture section replaced with src/lofbench/ map + new 'Rendering Architecture (design, not yet built)' subsection linking .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md and rendering-architecture-2026-07-04.md (copied into the branch so the links resolve), Test Structure updated to test_core.py/test_renderers.py/test_scorers.py. Lattice section untouched -- verified byte-identical via diff against HEAD. agents.md untouched (still byte-identical to CLAUDE.md's Lattice section, diff confirms). README.org: group_size default fixed 8->4 (matches composite_lof_task signature), renderer list broadened to all five (canonical, noisy_parens, circle, nested_list, sexpr). Verification: grep for form.py/simplify.py/generate.py/dataset.py/cli.py/'bench generate'/'bench validate' across all three files returns nothing; 'uv run pytest --collect-only -q' collects 56 tests cleanly; 'uv run ruff check .' runs (after 'uv sync' pulled in the ruff dev-dependency that was missing from a fresh venv) and reports 15 pre-existing findings in analysis.py, unrelated/out of scope; 'uv run inspect eval src/lofbench/tasks/single.py --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514 -T n=1 --limit 1' reaches model init and fails only on missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, confirming task/dataset construction is valid. One process note: my worktree ships its own separate demo .lattice instance (a stale 'lattice init' seed, unrelated to this repo's real task DB) whose short code 'DB-1' collided with a demo task 'The Awakening' (task_01KJB54NPTRPTYCWCAV8DM2T4X) -- I mistakenly branch-linked and attempted a status transition against that demo task first before catching the mismatch; that demo instance is otherwise inert and this comment plus the branch-link/status-transition above are recorded against the correct live task_01KWQKYTDKAS6CZM0VEGV2GP3G. No deviations from the plan; scope boundary respected (no touches to single.py, composite.py, factory.py, analysis.py, or the renderer registry).

Review (cold, agent:claire-reviewer-db1). PASS — no rework. Verified branch off lattice tip 0d3218f (merge-base confirmed). Acceptance criteria, each checked independently: (a) grep of CLAUDE.md/README.org/agents.md for form.py|simplify.py|generate.py|dataset.py|cli.py|'bench generate'|'bench validate' -> zero hits. (b) '## Lattice' section byte-identical to lattice branch (diff exit 0). (c) README group_size default now 4 (matches composite.py:19 group_size:int=4); renderer row names all five registered renderers (canonical, noisy_parens, circle, nested_list, sexpr) matching _RENDERER_REGISTRY. (d) every documented command invokes: pytest collects 56 tests, ruff runs (15 pre-existing analysis.py findings, out of scope), inspect eval reaches model init and fails ONLY on missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (task construction succeeds); all -T params (n, n_groups, renderer, group_size) exist in the real task signatures. (e) architecture map spot-checked vs source: single_lof_task@single.py:17, composite_lof_task@composite.py:17, lof_single_scorer/lof_composite_scorer@lof_scorer.py:154/189, DIFFICULTY_CONFIGS@core.py:231, analysis.py imports pandas + load_curated_logs, FormRenderer ABC@base.py:21, create_single/composite_dataset@factory.py — all accurate. (f) both design-note links resolve; committed copies are byte-identical to the main repo's current working versions INCLUDING the amendments section (diff exit 0 for both). Committing them as tracked is correct — they were untracked context that implementers of DB-2/DB-3 need. Style: new prose is GOV.UK plain, untouched sections (Representation, Constraints, Lattice) not restyled. Adversarial full read: no wall — notebooks/ exists so that Constraint bullet is not a false claim, and the Rendering Architecture subsection correctly flags the archetype/injector design as not-yet-built vs the current registry. No inline fixes needed.
